case_name: Prafulla Kumar Das and Others with Pradip Chandra v State of Orissa and Others with Pramod Chandra
petitioner: Prafulla Kumar Das and Others with Pradip Chandra
facts: The appeal arises out of a judgment and order dated 23.4.1991 passed by the Orissa Administrative Tribunal at Bhubaneswar in Transferred Application No.402 of 1986.

In consonance with the stated practice, the respondent officials, in the present instance, were given 1973 as their year of allotment, although in actual point of time they took up service on varying dates in the year 1975.
The petition for special leave to appeal from the judgment of the Orissa High Court was then dismissed in limned by the Supreme Court.

This Act was once more the subject of challenge before the High Court of Orissa, but having regard to the Full Bench decision in Ananta Kumar Bose 1984 Indlaw ORI 75 (supra), the High Court dismissed the case of the petitioners before it.
issues: Validity of Section 2 of the Orissa Administrative Service, Class - II (Appointment of Officers Validation) Amendment Act, 1992
court_reasoning: The sanctity of a well-established rule must not be unsettled, and the principle of year of allotment was as well justified in terms of the decision of the High Court in Ananta Kumar Bose 1984 Indlaw ORI 75 (supra).
Once the concept and application of 'year of allotment' is upheld, necessarily the O.A.S. Class II direct recruits of 1973 would in the facts and circumstances be senior to the merger is ts.
holding: The Supreme Court held that the principle of year of allotment was justified and the petitioners' challenge to Section 2 of the Orissa Administrative Service, Class-II (Appointment of Officers Validation) Amendment Act, 1992 was dismissed.
